## What the 2022 National Ignition Facility Experiment Measured

A 2022 experiment at the National Ignition Facility reported achieving fusion ignition, a step toward inertial fusion energy. At the target, 2.05 megajoules of energy were delivered and 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy were generated.

That target-level comparison is an experimental result, not a measurement of net electricity produced or delivered to the grid. Practical energy production remains a longer-term direction requiring substantial scientific and technological development.
